is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae s.l. (page 1, 4).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study reports the frequency of the Vgsc L1014F (kdr-west) mutation (Table 1, page 7).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 1 provides the number of mosquitoes tested and the genotype counts (1014F/1014F, 1014F/1014L, 1014L/1014L) for each population (page 7).

african_field_population.evidence: The study uses wild mosquito populations collected from six communes in Benin (page 1, 4).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical study conducted in 2023 (page 2).

sub_country_location.evidence: The study provides data for specific communes: Akpro-Missérété, Porto-Novo, Allada, Bohicon, Lokossa, and Djougou (page 2, 3).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study was undertaken in April 2023 (page 2).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes new collections conducted in April 2023 for a specific evaluation of new-generation nets.

supplement.evidence: All necessary data, including genotype counts and bioassay results, are provided in the main text and tables.

assessment.summary: This study evaluated the bio-efficacy of Olyset Plus, PermaNet 3.0, and Interceptor G2 nets against pyrethroid-resistant Anopheles gambiae s.l. populations in six communes in Benin. It also genotyped the Vgsc L1014F (L995F) mutation and assessed metabolic enzyme activity.
